provenance.citation: Lee S-H, Erber WN, Porwit A, Tomonaga M, Peterson LC, for the ICSH. ICSH guidelines for the standardization of bone marrow specimens and reports. Int J Lab Hematol 2008;30(5):349-364.
provenance.notes: Bone marrow categories and M:E ratio follow ICSH 2008 §2.6.

description: Modern consensus 9-part differential: blasts, promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands/segs, eosinophils, basophils, monocytes, lymphocytes. Aggregates bands and segmented neutrophils into a single granulocyte category. Left-hand ergonomic key layout.

ME_ratio.label: M:E Ratio
ME_ratio.basis: ICSH 2008 §2.6: all granulocytes and monocytes and their precursors (myeloblasts, promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms, segmented neutrophils, eosinophils, basophils, promonocytes, monocytes) over erythroblasts at all stages. Note that a competing convention excludes monocytes.

templates.outSentence: A {{total}}-cell count reveals {{blasts}}% blasts, {{pro}}% promyelocytes, {{myelo}}% myelocytes, {{meta}}% metamyelocytes, {{gran}}% granulocytes (bands + segmented neutrophils), {{eos}}% eosinophils, {{baso}}% basophils, {{mono}}% monocytes, {{lymph}}% lymphocytes, and {{nrbc}}% erythroid precursors. M:E ratio {{ME_ratio}}.

specimenTypes.targetCountBasis: ICSH 2008 §2.6: at least 500 cells when a precise percentage of an abnormal cell type is required for diagnosis; at least 300 when the differential is not essential to it.

templates.outSentence: A {{total}}-cell differential count of peripheral blood reveals: {{gran}}% granulocytes (bands + segmented neutrophils), {{lymph}}% lymphocytes, {{mono}}% monocytes, {{eos}}% eosinophils, {{baso}}% basophils, {{blasts}}% blasts, {{pro}}% promyelocytes, {{myelo}}% myelocytes, {{meta}}% metamyelocytes, and {{nrbc}}% nucleated RBCs.

specimenTypes.targetCountBasis: CLSI H20-A2: 200 leucocytes for a reference differential.
